newsitem.title: USA: Conseco unit offers debt issue.
newsitem.headline: Conseco unit offers debt issue.

text.p: Conseco Inc said Friday its Conseco Financing Trust II subsidiary offered 325,000 of 8.70 percent Capital Trust Pass-Through Securities (TruPS) at $1,000 per security.
Each TruPS security will pay cumulative cash distributions at an annual rate of 8.7 percent of the stated $1,000 liquidation amount per security, semi-annually, starting May 15, 1997.
Proceeds from the offering of about $321.3 million will be used to repay bank debt.
Conseco is a financial services company.
